assemblies.description: A 3-row, three-contact-wide connector using three vertical header_long strips with equal pin ends and an included top retainer. The base is 2.54 mm plus 3 × 2.54 mm; the top adds 2.54 mm when fitted.
steps: Cut three 5-position sections of header_long (6.25 mm exposed at both ends). Push out pins 1, 5 from each strip; keep both end cells intact. Stand the strips vertically, counting from the bottom.
Pass 9 wires up through the rear opening before crimping. Crimp one socket per wire and insert the sockets into the backs of the housings until latched.
Place the three vertical strips into the bottom beam window, with one set of pin ends facing the keyed front opening. Mate one three-way housing with each active row.
Fit the included top retainer over the three empty top cells. It is printed beside the base in the same part file. Keep the rear wire opening clear.
assemblies.note: The stock and prepared header rows describe the same item before and after modification. Use 15 mm overall header_long stock (6.25 mm exposed on each side of a 2.5 mm insulator); LCSC C343639 is a 40-position strip cut to the required lengths. Wire colours identify conductors, not a pinout. Housing and uncrimped socket geometry use nominal Harwin M20 references; wire bends are illustrative.

assemblies.description: A printed basic wire holder converts a 6-position header_long with equal pin ends into a 3-contact connector. Empty plastic cells locate the header in the plate.
steps: Cut one 6-position section of header_long (6.25 mm exposed at both ends). Count from the key side (negative X in the model) and push out pins 1, 2, 6; keep the full plastic strip.
Pass 3 wires up through the rear opening before crimping. Crimp one socket per wire and insert the sockets into the backs of the housings until latched.
Mate the housing with the rear 6.25 mm pin ends, then lower the header and housing into their seats. The equal front ends face the front opening.
Check that the wires move freely through the rear opening and the contacts remain recessed inside the front edge.
assemblies.note: The stock and prepared header rows describe the same item before and after modification. Use 15 mm overall header_long stock (6.25 mm exposed on each side of a 2.5 mm insulator); LCSC C343639 is a 40-position strip cut to the required lengths.
